49ers WR Mike Evans is questionable (Achilles) and a game-time call for Sunday night's Vikings-49ers game. He's at FLEX for Mean Machine, which still has an empty RB slot.
Raiders TE Brock Bowers is questionable (ankle/quad), another game-time call. TotesMagoat already benched him for Colston Loveland on Thursday.
With Walker out, Emmett Johnson starts again for Kansas City. He's at FLEX for I Believe in Love, which trails Lemon Squeezy 43.16 to 0.00.

Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. could come off IR this weekend after two full practices. He's on Hurts So Good's IR. Titans rookie Carnell Tate is questionable but expected to play after a full Friday practice. He's on the Prepetente is the GOAT! bench.

No moves Friday. Week 11 byes: Falcons, Browns, Packers, Rams, Patriots and Seahawks. Prepetente is the GOAT! still has an empty RB slot with Mike Washington Jr. and Sean Tucker healthy on the bench. Rhamondre Stevenson is on the Patriots bye.
Week 11 payout (Highest-Scoring Defense): the Texans D/ST still leads with 15.00 for TotesMagoat. The other eleven starting defenses play Sunday or Monday.

stories.title: ChuckJ10 has two players ruled out in his FLEX spots and a 5‑5 record to protect
stories.dek: Kenneth Walker III and Omar Cooper Jr. are both out. Alvin Kamara and Chris Godwin Jr. are on the bench. Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 has until 1 PM Sunday.
body: Saturday morning lineup check, and the ugliest one belongs to a playoff team. Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 has Kenneth Walker III and Omar Cooper Jr. in its two FLEX slots. The Chiefs ruled Walker out with the groin injury that cost him Week 10, and the Jets ruled Cooper out with ankle and hip injuries. Both FLEX slots are guaranteed zeros right now.

To be fair to ChuckJ10, it's Saturday and the reports dropped Friday. Neither one is a dumb start yet. It becomes one at 1 PM Sunday. Alvin Kamara (90.10 points this season, 16.40 on this same bench in Week 10) and Chris Godwin Jr. (57.90) are both healthy, both playing and both sitting there. Cooper also started at FLEX in Week 10 and scored 0.00 after leaving early, so ChuckJ10 has seen this one before.

The stakes: Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 is 5-5 and holds the sixth seed on points, 1553.94 to Mean Machine's 1379.36 and Hurts So Good's 1244.34. The opponent this week is Hurts So Good, which leads 3.20 to 0.00 on Tyler Warren's Thursday. I've moved the line from 27 to 21 for the injuries. With the lineup fixed, ChuckJ10 should still be fine. Without it, MakeItRains gets a free shot at the sixth seed.

Around the league: superdog91 has Dalton Kincaid (doubtful) at FLEX for 50 Shades of Rae, with Keaton Mitchell and Malachi Fields on the bench. Mean Machine still has an empty RB slot, and that one isn't really BertDirty's fault: Kyren Williams, Quinshon Judkins and Josh Jacobs are on bye, Woody Marks and Emanuel Wilson are out, and the $200 back is already starting. He needs a free agent and has $800 left. Prepetente is the GOAT! has no excuse. Marco_Polo's second RB slot is empty with Mike Washington Jr. and Sean Tucker healthy on the bench. TotesMagoat benched Brock Bowers on Thursday, two days before anyone else knew it was a game-time call. Of course he did.

stories.title: Six games, four weeks left, and the commissioner's game ends Monday night
stories.dek: Lemon Squeezy is already up 43.16. Picken Weiners trails 15.40 and needs Ja'Marr Chase and Stefon Diggs on Monday night in Washington.
body: The board, with Thursday's points banked. Lemon Squeezy leads I Believe in Love 43.16 to 0.00 (Lemon Squeezy by 34, 86%). Mean Machine leads Young Love Hunters 20.70 to 0.00 (Mean Machine by 63, 98%). Chubb So Big I Waddle leads Picken Weiners 15.40 to 0.00, but Picken Weiners is still favored by 27 (81%). 50 Shades of Rae leads Prepetente is the GOAT! 5.70 to 5.40 (50 Shades of Rae by 37, 88%). Hurts So Good leads Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 3.20 to 0.00 (Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 by 21, 75%). Trevor Have I Ever leads Hanging with Hernandez 1.80 to 0.00 (Trevor Have I Ever by 20, 74%).

Sunday night is Vikings-49ers, and it matters. TotesMagoat has Justin Jefferson and Christian McCaffrey at FLEX. I have George Kittle. Buccaneer51 has T.J. Hockenson, RobMeyers has Aaron Jones Sr., G8rDuc has Jordan Mason, Marco_Polo has Brock Purdy and MakeItRains has Deebo Samuel Sr. BertDirty has Mike Evans, if he plays.

Monday night is Bengals at Washington, and that's where my game gets decided. Picken Weiners has Ja'Marr Chase and Stefon Diggs. Chubb So Big I Waddle has Chase Brown and Tee Higgins. Mean Machine starts Joe Burrow. If I'm down going into Monday, I'm watching the Bengals passing game with RobMeyers like two guys splitting the same pizza and arguing over it.

The race: Lemon Squeezy (9-1), 50 Shades of Rae (8-2), Picken Weiners (7-3), Trevor Have I Ever (6-4) and I Believe in Love (6-4), then three 5-5 teams for the last spot. Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 and Hurts So Good play each other, so one of them is 6-5 on Tuesday. Mean Machine gets Young Love Hunters. Dynasty angle: Hurts So Good owns all of its firsts. A loss to ChuckJ10 and MakeItRains should start taking calls.

stories.title: Lemon Squeezy is up 43.16 to 0.00 before anybody else has played
stories.dek: C.J. Stroud and the Texans D/ST do it again for TotesMagoat. Laquon Treadwell gives Buccaneer51 a zero, and Marco_Polo benches 24.40 points.
body: Texans 26, Colts 3, and the 9‑1 team got richer. Lemon Squeezy took 43.16 out of Thursday night: C.J. Stroud 21.46 (194 yards, 3 touchdowns, his third straight three-TD game), the Texans D/ST 15.00 and Jonathan Taylor 6.70. That's with Drake Maye out, Brock Bowers on the bench and Jaxon Smith-Njigba on bye. TotesMagoat still has Christian McCaffrey, Amon-Ra St. Brown, Justin Jefferson, Malik Nabers, Garrett Wilson, Jonah Coleman and Colston Loveland to come.

I Believe in Love had one Thursday player, Laquon Treadwell, the $12 pickup. Zero catches, 0.00 points. Buccaneer51 is down 43.16 with nine starters left, and the pregame line was already TotesMagoat by 34. Sunday is going to have to be the best day of Jared Goff's life.

The ugliest box score belongs to Prepetente is the GOAT!. Marco_Polo started Dalton Schultz (2.10) and Xavier Hutchinson (3.30). On the bench: Marlin Klein, 12.40 with a touchdown, and Kayshon Boutte, 12.00 with a touchdown. That's 24.40 sitting down, and Prepetente is the GOAT! trails 50 Shades of Rae 5.70 to 5.40. Credit where it's due: he benched the Colts D/ST (3.00) for the Bears, and J.K. Dobbins is finally in a running back slot. The other RB slot is still empty. It's Friday, Marco_Polo.

Now my problem. David Montgomery ran 26 times for 107 yards and scored 15.40 at FLEX for Chubb So Big I Waddle against Picken Weiners, which hasn't played yet. Emari Demercado, BertDirty's $200 back, got 4.90 and Nico Collins added 15.80, so Mean Machine leads Young Love Hunters 20.70 to 0.00 with one RB slot still empty. The Texans D/ST's 15.00 leads the Week 11 defense payout, and of course it belongs to TotesMagoat.

stories.title: Picken Weiners wins by 122.46, the commissioner pays himself again, and it's 7‑3
stories.dek: George Pickens' 43.50 takes the receiver payout. Lemon Squeezy is 9‑1, and Mean Machine has won four straight.
body: It's final, and yes, I'm leading with myself. Picken Weiners 208.12, Hanging with Hernandez 85.66. Derrick Henry got 19.00 on Monday night, which made it a 122.46-point win instead of 141.46. It's still the second-biggest margin of the season, behind superdog91's 137.60 in Week 9, and the fourth-highest score of 2026. George Pickens 43.50, Patrick Mahomes 37.42, Ja'Marr Chase 36.10. An 11-0 all-play week.

The payout: Week 10 was Highest-Scoring Receiver, and Pickens's 43.50 beat Chase's 36.10 and Jaxon Smith-Njigba's 32.10. Bill_Buttlicker, paid. That's Week 8 (Bhayshul Tuten) and Week 10 for the commissioner. ChuckJ10 can file a complaint with the commissioner.

The rest of the board: Lemon Squeezy beat Hurts So Good 173.72 to 156.98 on Christian McCaffrey's 49.30 and is 9-1. 50 Shades of Rae beat Young Love Hunters 111.64 to 63.10 and is 8-2. I Believe in Love beat Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 155.82 to 141.22. Trevor Have I Ever beat Chubb So Big I Waddle 146.38 to 86.42. Mean Machine beat Prepetente is the GOAT! 146.86 to 101.46, BertDirty's fourth straight win.

Roast of the week, and it's mine: Sam LaPorta started for 2.60 with Harold Fannin Jr. scoring 16.10 on my bench. Honorable mention to Young Love Hunters, the low score for the ninth time in ten weeks. Four weeks left before the playoffs. Top six right now: Lemon Squeezy, 50 Shades of Rae, Picken Weiners, Trevor Have I Ever, I Believe in Love and Ceedees ships coming! 🏆.

Four straight wins and up 20.70 to 0.00. The empty RB slot is real, but every back on the roster is on bye or out, so I'm grading BertDirty on a curve. Go grab a free agent, you've got $800.
Emmett Johnson starts again for Kansas City with Kenneth Walker III out, and Buccaneer51 has him at FLEX. Down 43.16, but 6-4 in year one. Good for you.

columns.title: TWO OUTS! IN THE FLEX! ON A 5‑5 TEAM!
columns.dek: Kenneth Walker III is out. Omar Cooper Jr. is out. Alvin Kamara is on the BENCH. ChuckJ10, IT'S SATURDAY!
body: KENNETH WALKER III! OUT! The Chiefs said it! It's on NFL.com! It's in WRITING! OMAR COOPER JR.! OUT! Ankle AND hip! TWO body parts! And where are they, Saturday morning? In the FLEX! BOTH FLEX SPOTS! For Ceedees ships coming! 🏆! A FIVE AND FIVE TEAM! IN A PLAYOFF RACE!

And who's on the bench? ALVIN KAMARA! Ninety points this season! He scored 16.40 ON THAT SAME BENCH last week while Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 lost by 14.60! CHRIS GODWIN JR.! Playing! Healthy! Sitting there like a guy at the DMV holding number 47 when they're calling 12!

I'm not saying ChuckJ10 is going to blow it. It's Saturday. There's TIME. I'm saying I've seen this before! Omar Cooper Jr. was in the FLEX LAST WEEK and scored ZERO! ZERO POINTS! And you know who's playing them? HURTS SO GOOD! MakeItRains is already up 3.20 because of TYLER WARREN on a THURSDAY! It's a 309.60-point tiebreaker cushion over Hurts So Good, ChuckJ10! Don't hand it to him!

And then there's TotesMagoat! He benched Brock Bowers on THURSDAY! Bowers didn't become a game-time call until FRIDAY! The man is reading injury reports from THE FUTURE! NINE AND ONE! ZERO FAAB DOLLARS! I need to lie down! I CAN'T LIE DOWN, I HAVE TO CHECK THE INACTIVES!

columns.title: Two empty slots, and only one of them is excusable
columns.dek: BertDirty has a real problem. Marco_Polo has a lineup he hasn't touched.
body: Two teams in this league have an empty running back slot going into Sunday. I looked at both rosters this morning, because somebody has to.

Mean Machine first. BertDirty's backs: Kyren Williams, Rams bye. Quinshon Judkins, Browns bye. Josh Jacobs, Packers bye and out anyway. Woody Marks, out with a concussion. Emanuel Wilson, out, and the Seahawks are on bye too. Emari Demercado, the $200 man, is already starting and scored 4.90 Thursday. That's not negligence. That's a depth chart that got hit by the schedule. The fix is a free agent, and he has $800 to spend. Do it before Sunday and I have no complaints.

Prepetente is the GOAT! is different. Marco_Polo has Mike Washington Jr. and Sean Tucker on the bench. Both healthy. Both play Sunday. Neither one is in the lineup. Rhamondre Stevenson is on the Patriots bye, fine, but you only need one body. That empty slot has been there since before Thursday.

You're down 0.30 to an 8-2 team whose flex tight end is doubtful. That's as close as a 3-7 team gets to a free shot. Put a running back in the slot. I played linebacker for nine years and never once took the field with ten guys on purpose.

columns.title: Holden McGroin's Thursday Night Checklist
columns.dek: Four rules for Colts-Texans. I've tested none of them.
body: 1. Start everybody on the Texans. Woody Marks is out with a concussion and David Montgomery is back, which means the Texans have one fewer running back than they did last week. Fewer players means more points for each one. That's division. Look it up.

2. Pay $200 for the backup. BertDirty bid $200 on Emari Demercado, and now Demercado is Montgomery's complement. Every great team has a great backup. Mean Machine has a $200 one. Nobody else in the league can say that, mostly because nobody else wanted to.

3. Empty roster spots are a market inefficiency. Marco_Polo has left both RB slots empty three weeks running, and Prepetente is the GOAT! is 3-7, which is three more wins than zero. An empty slot can't fumble. An empty slot can't get hurt. An empty slot scored 0.00 points, which is more than the Falcons D/ST scored on BertDirty's bench in Week 10 (-2.00). Undefeated logic, again.

4. Pick up a Titan in the middle of the week. MakeItRains added Chimere Dike on Wednesday without dropping anybody, which is the most confident move in the league. If you have an open roster spot, fill it with a guy whose team isn't playing Thursday. That way he can't hurt you until Sunday.

columns.title: Points per Thursday starter: Lemon Squeezy is +14.39 over expectation
columns.dek: Three Thursday starters, 43.16 points, and a stat I made up on the way to the sideline.
body: Lemon Squeezy started three players on Thursday and scored 43.16. That's 14.39 points per Thursday starter. The rest of the league started nine Thursday players and scored 52.20 combined, which is 5.80 per starter. So TotesMagoat is +8.59 per head over the field, which I'm rounding up to +14.39 because that's a nicer number and it's my column.

Now the bench. Marco_Polo left 24.40 points on the bench Thursday with Marlin Klein and Kayshon Boutte, and started 5.40. That's a Bench-to-Starter Ratio of 4.52. Anything over 1.00 means your bench is better than your lineup. By my model, the correct move for Prepetente is the GOAT! is to start the bench and bench the starters. I've sent the model to Marco_Polo. He has not responded.

Finally, the defense payout. The Texans D/ST scored 15.00 and the Colts D/ST scored 3.00, so the Texans have a 5.00 Defense Dominance Multiple. Historically, teams that lead the defense payout after Thursday win the defense payout 100% of the time, in the one week this league has had a defense payout. I'm not saying it's over. I'm saying my spreadsheet already turned the cell green.

th.note: Every trade in Sleeper history, 2019 through 2025, graded by what each side actually got. Value = PPR fantasy points each player scored from the day of the trade through Week 8 of 2026. Picks count the player who was actually drafted with that pick, from his rookie year on. It measures production, not trade value today: a 2025 rookie hasn't had time to catch up to a five-year vet.
th.ledgerNote: Graded trades only. Net = points received minus points sent, added up across every trade. Former managers in italics.

top.t: The Trade That Built an Empire
top.take: In January 2020, superdog91 sent the picks that became Justin Jefferson and Justin Herbert to TotesMagoat for Devin Singletary and a third. Jefferson and Herbert have scored 3,708.3 points since. TotesMagoat has four titles. superdog91 has three, which is impressive given he handed his rival the keys.

Bill_Buttlicker got Patrick Mahomes and the pick that became Chuba Hubbard. G8rDuc got Drew Brees, who retired after the season, and the Michael Carter pick. The scoreboard says 2,853.1 to 529.9. G8rDuc is 22-80 all time, and this is part of why.

ChuckJ10 bought Michael Thomas in November 2020 and paid with Christian Kirk plus his 2021 and 2022 firsts. Thomas gave him 220.1 points. The 2022 first became Chris Olave. ChuckJ10 has never made a final, and trades like this are a big reason why.

superdog91 got Kenny Gainwell and the picks that became George Pickens (#16) and Kyren Williams, a fourth-rounder at #40, all for Devin Singletary. Kyren alone has 970.9 points. RedDevil904 still has never made the playoffs.

RedDevil904 sent five picks to Bill_Buttlicker for Christian McCaffrey. Those picks became Javonte Williams, Elijah Moore, Kenneth Walker III, Malik Willis and Roschon Johnson. CMC gave RedDevil904 1,482.6 points. The picks have given 2,855.7.

TotesMagoat got Amon-Ra St. Brown from Besch42 for Mecole Hardman Jr. and Quintez Cephus. St. Brown has 1,598.9 points since. Four months later, Besch42 lost the 2021 final to TotesMagoat. He'd handed him the WR1 himself.

Self-roast time. Bill_Buttlicker traded the picks that became DeVonta Smith (#11) and Kenny Gainwell to RedDevil904 for Miles Sanders. Sanders: 524.5. Smith and Gainwell: 1,782.6. The man who runs this website did that.

top.t: Pollard for a Pick That Missed
top.take: superdog91 sent Tony Pollard to ChuckJ10 for a 2021 second that became Terrace Marshall. Pollard has 1,255.7 points since. Marshall has 155.8.
